snippet.title: Adrián de la Cruz
snippet.description:
Vivo en una finca en la montaña junto a mis animales y comparto mi vida prácticamente tal y como ocurre.

Aquí encontrarás vida rural, animales, proyectos en la finca, bricolaje, autosuficiencia, apicultura, problemas que voy solucionando y todo lo que implica intentar vivir de una forma un poco más independiente.

Fui Policía Nacional y llevo más de 10 años dedicado al mundo de la supervivencia y la preparación ante emergencias, así que también comparto lo que he aprendido sobre seguridad, agua, energía, preparación del hogar y cómo depender menos de un sistema que puede fallar en cualquier momento.

No soy un paranoico, ni un prepper loco. Simplemente intento aprender, mejorar mi entorno y construir una vida con más libertad.

Actualmente estoy documentando todo este proceso a través de vídeos diarios.

Si te gustan los animales, la vida en el campo, la autosuficiencia, los proyectos prácticos y acompañarme en todo lo que vaya ocurriendo por aquí, te doy la bienvenida!

snippet.title: Kimono Mom
snippet.description:
Hi, I’m Moe. I am a Japanese mom and the founder of Kimono Mom. I was born in Kyoto, Japan and worked as a geisha. Now I live in the United States with my family.

This channel shares simple healthy Japanese home cooking.

I started this journey after I gave birth to my daughter in 2019. I went through postpartum depression and felt lost.

I began filming in a small kitchen in Tokyo. Cooking and sharing my daily life helped me come back to myself.

Today, I am building Kimono Mom as a global food brand.

Our viewers are all around the world. We call them Kimonoko. They are not just viewers. They are part of this journey. This community means a lot to me.

My goal is to build a food system that brings warm meals and care to families around the world.

I am also creating food products and systems that help busy families enjoy warm meals at home.

If you are building your life, raising a family, or working toward something important, I hope this channel gives you strength.

snippet.title: American Thrivalist
snippet.description:
Disaster-Proof Your Family: Welcome to American Thrivalist! This channel is all about helping everyday families prepare for the unexpected - from natural disasters to long term emergencies - with practical, step-by-step guidance.

Here, you'll find clear strategies, gear reviews, and real-world training that equips you to thrive, not just survive. Our perspective is rooted in faith over fear - believing that preparation isn't about panic, but about stewardship, resilience, and protecting the people we love.

With a heart that none should perish, we're building a community of families ready to stand strong when it matters most. Whether you're new to preparedness or looking to refine your 72-hour kit, long-term food storage or family evacuation plan, you'll find the tools, wisdom, and encouragement to take the next step.

Subscribe and join us on this journey to becoming Disaster-Proof, because the best way to face uncertainty is with confidence, courage and community.
